regions.full_page: Dear Mrs. Kenny: God bless you and yours. I came down from Retreat in Garrison a few days ago to find quite a stack of letters a- waiting opening. I just came to yours of the 23nd and sure do sympathize with you and your family. However, we've had so many decidedly worse reports than about your Pat, that turned out most remarkable after several months of suspence and anxiety, that I shall still hope for a good word about Son Patrick F. At all events I have just enrolled him in the Seraphic Masses as requested and we shall not be surprised at any favorable report to come. We'll pray and hope - trusting in God for the best. After all if we look at things in light of faith, the worst, as the world considers things, is only cur Victory - according to our dear Lord's own words: "Greater love than this no man hath that a man give his life for his friends". This I think ought to buoy us up as it is needed in millions of sad bereavements these days ... God bless you again and love to all the family and friends
